quotes.rework_hand_lock_removed: Champions will not bring 3-card cycle anymore: they come back to the player's cycle like any other card. [Version History/2025 revid 436887, '2025 Quarter 3 Update (29/9/2025)', Champion Rework]
quotes.rework_ability_owner: Only the most recent placed Champion has the ability. / The Champion that possesses the ability has a crown icon. / Cooldowns are reset when the ability is transferred between Champions. / Skeleton King's soul bar resets during ability transference. [same section]

quotes.cards_master_current: All Champion cards are troops, and when they are deployed, an ability icon will appear at the right-hand side of the player's screen. At any time, the player can tap the icon in order to activate their Champion's unique ability. Activating an ability costs a certain amount of Elixir. The abilities adhere to the server's 1 second deployment delay. After the ability's duration concludes, the abilities will go on a cooldown, which prevents them from being used for some time. The cooldown will instantly reset if the player's Champion dies, or if a new Champion gets placed (as in the same Champion card or through a Mirror). [Cards revid 437053]
quotes.cards_master_button: The most recent Champion card placed will be able to use its ability. [Cards revid 437053]
quotes.cards_master_deck: Up to 2 Champion cards can be present in a deck at any time. [Cards revid 437053]
quotes.cards_master_clone: Cloned Champion troops cannot use abilities. Activating an ability while a cloned Champion is on the arena will only trigger it for the original troop. [Cards revid 437053]
quotes.single_use_2026: Champions and Heroes (minus Boss Bandit): Will no longer have multi-use abilities. Instead, they will be single use [Version History revid 437451, Balance Changes (4/8/2026)]
quotes.heroes_refund: When a Hero activates their ability, but did not start casting it before they are defeated, the Elixir spent on the ability will be refunded once they are defeated. [Heroes revid 437509 -- written for Heroes; champion pages carry no refund text]
quotes.heroes_slots: Only two Heroes can be in a deck at a time, and only in the Hero and Wild slots. Those slots are also shared with Champion card, which means that the player can have 1 Hero and 1 Champion at the same time. [Heroes revid 437509]
quotes.heroes_slot_unlock: The Champion slot is unlocked at Arena 5, while the Wild slot is unlocked at Arena 10. [Heroes revid 437509]
quotes.midmarch_slots: The special slots are changed to 1evo-1hero-1wild (from 2evo-2hero) / Wild slot can have either 1 evo or 1 hero [Version History revid 437451, 2026 Mid-March Update (16/3/2026)]

findings.a_same_champion_coexist: IMPLIED COEXIST, NOT EXPLICIT. The rework speaks of the ability being 'transferred between Champions' and the Cards page of the cooldown resetting 'if a new Champion gets placed (as in the same Champion card or through a Mirror)' -- both presuppose two bodies alive at once, and no source says the second deploy replaces or kills the first. Needs owner in-game confirmation.
findings.b_which_body_gets_button: The MOST RECENTLY PLACED champion body owns the single ability button; it is marked with a crown icon. Older bodies stay on the field without ability access.
findings.c_uses_cooldowns_per_body: Cooldown resets when the ability transfers to a new body (new placement) and when the owning champion dies. Since 4/8/2026 abilities are SINGLE USE per possession for all champions except Boss Bandit (multi-use retained). Whether a newly placed second body refreshes the spent use is undocumented.
findings.d_elixir_refund: Documented verbatim only for Heroes: elixir refunded if the body is defeated after buying the ability but before the cast starts. Heroes' ability gimmick is stated to be 'shared with Champion cards' (Heroes revid 437509), so it presumably applies to champions, but no champion-specific refund text exists post-rework.
findings.e_deck_slots: Champions and Heroes share the two special slots: Champion/Hero slot (Arena 5) + Wild slot (Arena 10; holds 1 evo OR 1 hero/champion). Max two champion-rarity/hero cards per deck in any mix; 'Up to 2 Champion cards can be present in a deck at any time' (Cards). The rework-era 'only one Champion per deck' (29/9/2025) is superseded by the Heroes launch (1/12/2025) and the 2026 Mid-March slot format.
